title: [Environment Variables] This APP crashed with Chinese Simplified (windows default)
author: KagaJiankui
summary: The public thread already demonstrates a language-specific crash that reproduces across multiple CJK languages, so the next step is a maintainer-side startup repro with a focused resource/title-path design rather than another reporter request.

judgment.rationale: The issue now has both a bug-report ZIP and a later confirmation that zh-CN, zh-TW, and ja-JP reproduce in v0.101.2242, which is enough to reproduce locally and narrow the startup resource path.
evidence: The reporter says Environment Variables crashes when PowerToys language follows Windows default on zh-CN, but works when PowerToys language is forced to English.
The thread includes a PowerToys bug-report ZIP.
A later commenter confirms zh-CN, zh-TW, and ja-JP all reproduce in v0.101.2242.

Current Environment Variables startup already applies LanguageHelper.LoadLanguage() and also includes an empty-title fallback in MainWindow.xaml.cs, so the remaining failure is likely in another localized startup resource path rather than the simplest missing-override bug.
judgment.recommended_action: Run a debugger-backed local repro on a CJK language build and design the smallest startup-resource hardening needed to keep Environment Variables alive when localized resources resolve late or empty.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue still looks like a real PowerToys startup bug, but the exact failing localized resource/title path is not yet identified in the public thread.

proposed_fixes.title: Harden Environment Variables startup against failing localized resource resolution
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The most plausible remaining cause is an early localized startup path that still assumes a successfully resolved resource or title string under CJK languages. The obvious language-override and empty-window-title guards exist in current source, so the crash likely sits in another startup string or TitleBar-related resource lookup.
plan: Reproduce the crash under zh-CN/zh-TW/ja-JP with current main and capture the first-chance exception site.
Audit Environment Variables startup for localized resource reads that occur before the window is fully initialized or that assume non-empty resource values.
Add the narrowest fallback or deferred initialization needed so the app survives localized startup and still shows translated UI.
verification: Launch Environment Variables under zh-CN, zh-TW, and ja-JP with PowerToys language set to Windows Default and confirm the window stays open.
Switch PowerToys language back to English and verify no regression in the existing successful path.

confidence.rationale: The issue is clearly reproducible, but current main already contains the two most obvious startup safeguards, so the exact failing localized resource path still needs live debugging.

issue_context.summary: Environment Variables crashes only when it launches under CJK language settings, and later comments broaden the repro from zh-CN to zh-TW and ja-JP.
known_information: The issue includes a PowerToys diagnostic ZIP and a six-step reproduction flow.
English mode works, which narrows the bug to localized startup behavior rather than general launch failure.
A later commenter confirmed the same bug in multiple CJK languages on v0.101.2242.
No assignee or linked fix attempt is visible.
inferences: The failure is likely inside Environment Variables startup/resource handling rather than in the global PowerToys language selection setting.
Because multiple CJK languages reproduce, the bug is probably tied to localization/resource loading patterns rather than a single mistranslated string.
issue_context.analysis: This is best represented as reproducible with a maintainer-side reproduce action. The remaining uncertainty is internal debugging detail, not missing reporter evidence.
initial_investigation: src/modules/EnvironmentVariables/EnvironmentVariables/EnvironmentVariablesXAML/App.xaml.cs already applies LanguageHelper.LoadLanguage() and PrimaryLanguageOverride before InitializeComponent().
commit de4859454 added a MainWindow.xaml.cs fallback title specifically to avoid WinUI TitleBar startup faults when a localized title resolves empty.
EnvironmentVariablesUILib still reads localized strings from ResourceLoaderInstance during startup/view-model creation, which leaves room for another early resource-resolution failure path.

actions.label: Approve Environment Variables CJK startup design
actions.note: The crash is reproducible, but the exact startup resource path still needs debugger confirmation before code changes are narrowed.

actions.label: Reproduce Environment Variables crash under CJK languages
actions.note: Use a current build with Windows Default language selection and capture the first failing startup resource path.

prerequisites: Set Windows display language to zh-CN, zh-TW, or ja-JP.
Set PowerToys language to Windows Default and restart PowerToys.
steps: Launch Environment Variables from the PowerToys tray or settings.
Observe whether the window appears and closes within a few seconds.
Repeat under at least two of zh-CN, zh-TW, and ja-JP to confirm the language family behavior.
Compare against the same flow with PowerToys language forced to English.
reproduce.expected_result: The app should stay open and render localized UI under each tested language instead of crashing on startup.
